## Hypothesis

We are assessing the top keeper from the sniper_real_fills_grinder output (5 keepers total) to determine if it represents genuine edge or overfit, identify which knob changes drove any improvement vs baseline, and evaluate its readiness for promotion. The combo shows mixed performance on J anchor days: significant underperformance on winner days (4/29, 5/04) but improved behavior on loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07). Missing 5/01 data prevents complete OP-16 assessment.

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- Missing critical 5/01 J day data, truncated by_day, no OOS/WF evidence, and underperformance on winner days (4/29, 5/04) raises overfit concerns. Loser day improvement is encouraging but insufficient without winner day capture.
